answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. To join, a name must pass Curdbound scrubber scent writ, which works because a writ scrubbers sign after wash room audits. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Nobody is waved through free: £38 in fees and a 7-day delay before the stamp dries is the price, and the inlet never covers it twice. The clerk notes thread. opal is written on the receipt.
